sources.title: Introducing upgrades to Codex
sources.evidence: September 15, 2025 release makes GPT-5-Codex available in Codex and identifies it as a GPT-5 variant trained for software engineering. A separately dated September 23 update announces Responses API access. Describes image input and adaptive hidden reasoning; the API name is updated over time.

sources.title: GPT-5-Codex model documentation
sources.evidence: Full exact-model Markdown fetched. Documents 400,000 context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning tokens, function calling and prompt caching. Responses-only service is marked shut down; no dated immutable snapshot is exposed.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-5 system card: GPT-5-Codex
sources.evidence: Original September 15 system card downloaded and text-extracted. Describes reinforcement learning on real coding tasks and tool use. Its evaluations do not disclose total/active production parameters or dense/MoE routing.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Full Markdown read. The guide scopes itself to pre-GPT-5.6 API models and describes caching through Transformer attention layers and key/value tensors. Read together with explicit GPT-5-Codex prompt-caching support, it supplies operational evidence rather than a complete architecture report.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: The April 22, 2026 legacy-model notice explicitly lists gpt-5-codex for July 23, 2026 API shutdown. It is historical service status, not a live endpoint test.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current terms grant service/API access and reserve service intellectual property in sections 2.2 and 9.1. Used for descriptive proprietary classification, not a downloadable checkpoint license or a claim that these exact terms applied at launch.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card
sources.evidence: Later system card downloaded and text-extracted. Comparison tables explicitly include original GPT-5-Codex but report evaluation results, not model sizes or architecture. No original-model parameter or routing disclosure found.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-5.2 System Card: GPT-5.2-Codex
sources.evidence: Later system card downloaded and text-extracted. Original GPT-5-Codex appears in capability comparisons; no total/active parameter count or exact architectural structure is disclosed for it. Later-model specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Full Markdown read. Responses supports PDF file input for vision-capable models, processing PDFs into extracted text and page images. Combined with exact GPT-5-Codex vision and Responses support, this establishes API document input. No Codex-specific exclusion was found in the guide or targeted primary-source search; omission of a file_uploads feature flag is not evidence of non-support.

name.note: Official name; distinct from subsequent GPT-5.1/5.2 Codex models.

developer.note: Original developer announcement and system card.

family.note: Explicitly a GPT-5 variant; replace the cross-generation gpt-codex bucket.

release_date.note: First public Codex release; September 23 API access is a separate availability milestone.

open_weights.note: Published as a hosted model through Codex and subsequently the API. Local Codex clients do not imply downloadable model weights.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification under service terms, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: No total production count in exact specifications, original card or checked later comparison cards. Training steps, tokens and evaluation results are not parameter counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token count or routing disclosure found. It is not inferred from a presumed architecture or equated to total parameters.

architecture.note: Cross-source operational inference: exact model support for prompt caching and the applicable OpenAI mechanism establish Transformer attention. This does not establish exclusively Transformer layers, a complete block inventory, dense/MoE routing or counts.

context_window.note: Exact published context; 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output are separate limits.

modalities.note: Native inputs are text and images, with text output. PDF is an API document format inferred from exact vision/Responses support and the official processing rule: the API sends extracted text and page images. No separate native PDF modality or live-endpoint test is claimed.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning-token support and original discussion of adaptive hidden reasoning.

tool_call.note: Exact documentation supports function calling; original card independently describes tool use.

description.value: GPT-5 variant trained for software engineering, including code changes, tests and reviews, with text and image input and function calling.
description.note: Use documented training focus and interfaces without comparative quality or performance claims.

Addendum to GPT-5.2 System Card: GPT-5.2-Codex

patch.notes: First released in Codex on September 15, 2025; Responses API access followed September 23. The gpt-5-codex name referred to an updateable model, not a frozen dated snapshot. Listed context and capabilities are its last-documented specifications. OpenAI lists API shutdown on July 23, 2026; no live endpoint request was made. PDF denotes API file input processed into text and page images, supported by combining the exact vision/Responses interface with the documented PDF rule. Broad Transformer attention is inferred from exact prompt-caching support and the documented mechanism. Complete structure, dense/MoE routing and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed.

summary: Confirmed first Codex release separately from API availability, context, text/image interface, reasoning and tools. Corrected family and proprietary classification, added qualified Transformer evidence, PDF API input with processing scope and plain description, and recorded July 2026 API shutdown. Production counts and routing remain undisclosed after original and later system-card checks.
